items.name: Direction and responsibility register
items.owns: Original endorsed purpose, decisions, accepted mandates, actual principals, outcome/duty custodians, alternatives and surviving obligations
items.cannot: cannot infer new personal values or extinguish third-party standing

attributes.purpose: Preserve the actual company's endorsed ends, boundaries and accountable custody across the complete venture and institutional lifecycle.
attributes.responsibility: Record exact IntentVersion, principal/standing, mandates and accepted ResponsibilityAssignment; resolve legitimate decision domains and transfer only acknowledged scope. Keep potential and surviving obligations linked to the actual principal.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Does not infer founder values, manufacture legal identity or competence, issue transport authority, select its own independent evaluator, or declare native payment/customer facts true.
attributes.owner: An accepted ResponsibilityAssignment covering C01, held by the actual direction/ownership custodian under the Principal and Mandate; values/taste remain with their legitimate owner. Actual identities, shared-decision rule and alternate are admission inputs, not invented officers.
attributes.interfaces: company.intent.propose/endorse, human.mandate.accept and company.record.propose on the common command endpoint; current records/queries to C02/C04/C07 and permission-filtered C09. Changes that alter authority scope invoke C04/C08 migration.
attributes.inputs: Authenticated original statements/corrections, source identity/standing evidence, accepted assignments, AuthorityMatrix rules, contrary facts, scope and effective time, current expected revisions and dependencies.
attributes.outputs: Exact IntentVersion/Mandate/assignment/DecisionRecord refs, scoped purpose and deciding rule, preserved disagreement and owned questions; no new Grant or factual guarantee merely from endorsement.
attributes.state: Canonical intent/mandate/assignment and domain direction records plus their revisions and effective intervals; derived portfolio/ownership views carry witnessed Position and omissions. No independent component-level truth flag.
attributes.lifecycle: Bootstrap only through the kernel's actual-principal/root-assignment rule; admit bounded direction work, maintain corrections and reviews, quiesce affected changes during disputes, transfer acknowledged duties, then retire only after surviving obligations and archival access are assigned.
attributes.dependencies: Kernel identity/version/command serialization; C07 actual authority/competence and acceptance; C05 source validity; C06 scoped evidence; C08 durable history/recovery; domain Goal/Mission/Project/Workstream interfaces.
attributes.trust: Authenticated endorsement is authoritative only for the issuer's actual domain. A correct signature or company namespace is not proof of legal standing, factual truth, professional capacity or agreement of other required parties.
attributes.permissions: Command-scoped mutation of C01 records through the protected application; no raw database administration or R key. Readers see only current principal/purpose-permitted records; changing responsibility cannot broaden a worker's Grant.
attributes.failure: Ambiguous/contested intent creates an owned decision without replacing original words; missing standing blocks dependent exposure while unrelated admitted research continues. Failed handoff retains old or genuinely accepted alternate custody.
attributes.observability: Endorsement/interpretation differences, overdue direction reviews, missing assignments, disputed decision rules, owner response windows and duties without accepted successor; full history and source watermarks visible within access.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C01: a legitimate changed intent updates future work; inferred enthusiasm fails endorsement; joint-party withdrawal blocks the exact decision; a transfer with missing competence/access cannot remove old custody. Useful one-goal work proceeds without a mandatory hierarchy.
attributes.scaling: Use scoped typed queries and derived portfolio views within the one admitted registry order. More ventures/principals do not create issuers or merge money/liability; cross-scope changes serialize and require measured load before partitioning.
attributes.version: Intent and meaning revisions preserve original/effective time. AuthorityMatrix/policy amendments are ProtectedChanges where relevant; canonical schema changes use explicit SemanticMappingVersion and compatible migrations, not aliases as new stored types.
attributes.replacement: Export original statements, exact history/decisions, standing evidence, assignments, duties and omissions; successor accepts current scope, demonstrates access and interpretation, and fences the old mutation route before one new writer activates.
attributes.removal: May retire an obsolete direction view/procedure, never the company's surviving responsibility account. Close or transfer ventures/duties under actual standing, revoke old actors and preserve authorized records; unresolved ownership blocks complete removal.

items.name: Case admission and scheduler
items.owns: Admitted agenda, dependencies, procedure state, bounded adaptive work, causal consumption, deadlines and ownership-resolution state
items.returns: admitted work, parked work or explained refusal
items.cannot: cannot mint consequence grants or invent missing competence

attributes.purpose: Turn legitimate outcomes and duties into finite useful work while preserving actual capacity, deadlines and responsibility.
attributes.responsibility: Admit Cases/WorkOrders, reserve causal resources through C04, maintain WorkflowRun/StepExecution cursor, assign temporary workers, leases, dependencies, schedules, progress and Continuation. Record missed service and no-progress without erasing the duty.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Does not define founder ends, mint capacity/competence, accept its own produced outcome, discharge native effects, multiply budgets by delegation, or implement another durable release protocol.
attributes.owner: Accepted scheduling/work ResponsibilityAssignment and mandate with a named actual sponsor/alternate for due work. Kernel automation executes this policy; an agent template is not the accountable owner.
attributes.interfaces: case.propose/admit/transition, worker lifecycle commands, work.* and skill.* contracts; SQL inbox/outbox/timers and current C05/C06 predicates; receives C07 decisions and publishes scoped work/status to C09.
attributes.inputs: Exact intent/outcome/acceptance refs, obligations/latest responsible times, dependency predicates, current source/authority, actual executor/reviewer/human slots, ResourceAccount/Reservation, admitted workflow/skill/runtime and prior continuation.
attributes.outputs: Finite WorkOrder/Case/delegation/schedule refs, cursor transitions, reservations and stage exports; explicit Blocker/FailureRecord, missed-occurrence/duty account and current continuation. Work admission is not external release or customer acceptance.
attributes.state: Canonical Case/WorkOrder/CausalEpisode and domain workflow/message/schedule state; lease generation/epoch and timer identity remain durable. Execution reported, acceptance_pending and accepted stay distinct; StepExecution cannot override OperationStatus.
attributes.lifecycle: Propose → admit only current prerequisites → dispatch/lease/run → report/assess or park/recover → accepted/cancelled with remaining duties accounted. Occurrences choose individual reconciliation/coalesce/skip-expired/escalate; missed is never completed by a later timer.
attributes.dependencies: C01 legitimate scope/custody; C04 reservations/current authority; C05 context/validity; C03 production; C06 exact accepted outcomes; C07 real performance/attention; C08 witnessed command/restore and finite cleanup capacity.
attributes.trust: Workers' requested children/read lists/progress are proposals or testimony. Heartbeat shows liveness only; schedule time is not authority. SQL timer wakeups cannot alter statutory or customer deadlines.
attributes.permissions: Only guarded scheduler/worker commands, no untrusted C03 database login. One lease per mutable scope, current expected revisions, finite root allowance and default bounded delegation; grants attenuate rather than copy parent credentials.
attributes.failure: Pure transaction retry stays bounded; semantic retry needs changed method/input within allowance. Missing acknowledgment/heartbeat parks and reconciles; duplicate commands return stable status. Incompatible combined changes become owned integration work; cancellation preserves unknown effects.
attributes.observability: WIP, exact lease age/epoch, last meaningful progress, backlog/deadline slack, deferred protected service, causal reserved/consumed totals, duplicate/missed schedule occurrences, source gaps and unfinished handoff scope.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C02: useful scheduled invoice/service completes; lost/double occurrence cannot duplicate effect; parent/child retry share allowance; two textual-clean but meaning-conflicting changes fail integration; witness outage permits only bounded D1 staging/current admitted local computation.
attributes.scaling: Initial one WorkOrder per executor and one native producer per profile; capacity is the minimum of actual compute/provider/review/human constraints. SQL SKIP LOCKED is queue claiming only. Increase concurrency after measured useful throughput/R-G pressure, never infer conflict absence from skipped rows.
attributes.version: Runs pin exact workflow/skill/template/runtime and predicate versions. Migrate cursor/input/unknown-effect semantics explicitly; old and new schedules have stable occurrence mapping so version changes do not double-fire a due act.
attributes.replacement: Park/fence dispatch, export Cases/orders/cursors/dependencies/leases/causal consumption/schedule occurrences/continuations; successor accepts and revalidates current authority, then activates a single dispatcher. No replay of external effects to reconstruct state.
attributes.removal: Drain or assign every active/parked order, future due occurrence and unresolved dependency; revoke worker/session access and retire timers only with a recorded missed/closed/transferred disposition. Removing a queue cannot remove a customer's entitlement.

items.name: Domain production interfaces
items.owns: Native business records, artifact drafts, local execution/procedure state, semantic mappings and capability contracts
items.receives: Exact work contract and scoped context
items.returns: actual output, attempt evidence and unfinished duties
items.cannot: cannot accept their own unsupported success

attributes.purpose: Produce actual useful company work and attributable artifacts across research, offers, delivery, support, finance, people and institutional operation.
attributes.responsibility: Run admitted deterministic/native/human-capable procedures, use current authorized context, create staged artifacts and AttemptReports, expose failures/uncertainty and request exact external operations through C04. Follow CAP procedures and IC adapter contracts.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Cannot endorse values, promote its own evidence to independent acceptance, issue grants/releases, assert professional standing, mutate protected registry/evaluator roots, or count a prepared packet as actual performance.
attributes.owner: An accepted C03 component ResponsibilityAssignment owns procedure/runtime integration maintenance and accountable reporting. Each actual outcome sponsor remains in the WorkOrder/ResponsibilityAssignment; the admitted executor is accountable for its report, and any human/professional performer has a separately accepted mandate. No permanent department/persona is created.
attributes.interfaces: worker.claim/checkpoint/report and artifact/context publication commands; integration.invoke for exact admitted adapters; C07 service handoff where actual human action is required; submits outputs to C06 and progress to C02.
attributes.inputs: One admitted WorkOrder with exact predicate, capability/skill/template/profile, ContextManifest, bounded invocation capabilities/resources, accepted performer availability and all material unresolved duties/contradictions.
attributes.outputs: Staged ArtifactVersion/AttemptReport, source observations, proposed OperationIntent and partials with omissions; native capture comes through protected C06/integration path. A useful artifact may exist even when the attempt's final message is missing.
attributes.state: Ephemeral scratch plus local StageRef or canonical staged artifact/report state; no private authoritative task database. Native session IDs, process/cgroup/lease and output sequence are execution observations tied to the same causal episode.
attributes.lifecycle: Eligible profile selected → current job admitted → isolated execute → captured report → independent assessment; interruption closes/fences execution and creates bounded continuation; provider/auth/lineage change requires new admission before resume.
attributes.dependencies: C02 finite scope; C05 complete delivered context; C04 exact operation/gate; C06 protected capture/acceptance; C07 accepted actual human service; C08 descendant/unknown reconciliation; admitted provider/account and billing evidence.
attributes.trust: Model text, tool output, repository content, attachments and claimed read sets are untrusted. N's subscription credential is a declared login root, separated from arbitrary code in X; provider output is neither a grant nor complete native truth.
attributes.permissions: C03 has no protected DB, admin, signing or company/provider production credentials. N/X clean standalone job environments, mediated tools and all-channel G egress apply; model-visible data must be authorized for its destination, including stdout and retained sessions.
attributes.failure: Capability mismatch, malformed result, no progress, quota/auth failure, partial execution and unknown effect remain separate. Salvage permitted artifacts as proposals, preserve cost/omissions and route real duties to available accepted service; never silently buy API/credit fallback.
attributes.observability: Exact job/template/model/config/context/tool identities, causal usage and opaque subcalls, stdout/capture gaps, last meaningful result, native auth/billing age, stop observation and unfinished duties; telemetry is not independent proof of accepted output.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C03: valid supplied-input native generation plus independent build/beneficiary acceptance; adversarial source tries to change payee; test stdout secret disclosure, forbidden startup context, quota interruption, fake completion and a physically unavailable performer. Safe refusal alone cannot pass production usefulness.
attributes.scaling: Add isolated workers only within actual provider, host, evidence-review and human capacity. More agents do not increase authority or independent evidence. One N plus one X is the initial operational estimate; local development follows separate memory/disk ceilings.
attributes.version: Pin runtime/template/skill/instruction/tool/profile and parser/context dependencies. Changed provider behavior or terms can invalidate eligibility without binary upgrade. Persistent resume is only an explicitly admitted profile with complete current ancestry.
attributes.replacement: Close/fence old lease/session, export allowed Continuation/artifacts/capture gaps and causal use; independently qualify substitute profile/performer and revalidate context/authority. Reconstruct from portable records when opaque session ancestry is unavailable.
attributes.removal: Destroy job resources and revoke job capabilities after capture/partial accounting; enumerate native sessions, deployed programs and other descendants. Remaining duties pass only through accepted responsibility transfer, while provider credentials/resources remain billable or effective until native removal is observed.

items.name: Consequence authority and release
items.owns: Grants, conflict holds, independent resource accounts, current restriction epochs, release order and controlled egress identities
items.receives: Exact proposed operation plus current prerequisites
items.cannot: no producer credentials or permission inferred from success

attributes.purpose: Make each consequential act depend on exact current authority, independent durability, bounded resources and truthful knowledge of its effects.
attributes.responsibility: Authenticate action authority, attenuate grants, resolve trusted parameters, reserve business conflicts/resources/potential duties, serialize prepare/release/send claim, enforce disclosure/validity and protected change policy, and maintain truthful OperationStatus with C08.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Does not invent business intent, factual/competence evidence or legal standing; witness signature is not factual acceptance. It cannot promise provider acceptance before expiry, instantaneous recall, exactly-once behavior from arbitrary providers or safety against its declared root administrators.
attributes.owner: Actual accepted authority/security ResponsibilityAssignment with scoped Mandate, independent competent assessment for protected changes and accepted alternate. Sole issuance is a logical contract, not an agent named chief executive or a claim that one human owns every decision domain.
attributes.interfaces: Common operation/grant/reservation/release/send-claim commands from 02; GET /v1/operations/{id}/status; R witness/proof lookup and G bounded transport. All callers use exact typed payloads, actor identity, revisions, current ContextManifest and causal reservations.
attributes.inputs: OperationIntent exact bytes/account/principal, parameter provenance, live identity/grant/validity epochs, participants/conflict map, accepted subject/predicate evidence, resource/duty holds, trusted-time admission and exact independent completeness receipt.
attributes.outputs: Guarded refusal, preparation/reservation, immutable Release/SendClaim business records and separate post-witness SendAuthorizationBundle/status proof. Status may expose unknown/partial effects; it is never a renewed permit or a receipt embedded in its own hash.
attributes.state: Canonical Grant/ResourceAccount/Reservation/OperationIntent/ConflictClaim/Release/SendClaim and epochs; exact registered attempt/effect/stop dimensions. BusinessResult/GroupBody are immutable, external signatures and current status are joined values/projections.
attributes.lifecycle: Prepare holds → independent complete envelope witness → ordered release → one-use witnessed send claim → bounded G transport → protected observation/reconciliation. Revoke/freeze stops new authority and contains finite issued exposure; rollback/migration never revives consumed or expired claims.
attributes.dependencies: C01 actual mandates; C05 current disclosure/lineage; C06 exact current independent judgments; C02 causal/work scope; C07 actual standing/competence; C08 full durable witness/frontier/key availability; admitted G/clock/credential roots and provider effect semantics.
attributes.trust: Pg administrator, R signer/admin, G clock/network root, IdP/CA custody and native account provider are declared roots with scoped exclusions. Separate process or account names alone prove no independence. Source text cannot choose trusted recipient/payee/account or evaluator.
attributes.permissions: Only protected command service may change control records; grants intersect actions/resources/destinations/purpose/budget/expiry/delegation depth. Workers cannot edit SQL schema/replication, mint grant or alter G. Consequential human decisions require exact current challenge and real authority/competence.
attributes.failure: Missing/contradictory/stale prerequisite denies dependent release, not all company computation. Lost ack looks up exact stable result/proof; ambiguous send keeps holds. G expiry bounds sk_buff admission at its named hook, while partial requests and later wire/provider effects remain reconcilable unknowns.
attributes.observability: Unconfirmed group age, prepare/release/send-claim positions, current restriction epochs, credential/time attestation, gate window/bytes, retained unknown holds, conflict scope migrations, native effect/status and stop phases; never reduce these to a green success flag.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C04: successful distinct-subject launch plus lost ack; wrong/stale JudgmentBinding fails; concurrent revocation/send claim, empty standby/local sync cancellation, delayed sender/pooled socket, scope alias migration and parameter injection retain required safety and useful valid progress.
attributes.scaling: One admitted writer/order per registry generation and one unconfirmed authoritative group/company initially. Batch pure compatible work only with unchanged atomicity; measure R/G witness latency and contention before enlargement. Independent departmental issuers require the explicitly reviewed extension, not spontaneous sharding.
attributes.version: ProtectedChange exact manifest governs policy/auth/gate/schema/meaning revisions. T-R1 freezes the union of old/new participant/business scopes, fences pending exposure and maps every unknown/potential duty before forward activation. No arbitrary mutation of proof formats or key membership.
attributes.replacement: Fence old issuer and transport, obtain current independent frontier, account all released/unknown work and current restrictions, qualify replacement roots/profile, then issue a new generation under authorized recovery. Old snapshots/receipts/status cannot renew authority.
attributes.removal: Stop new commitments, expire/revoke/fence grants and windows, reconcile native descendants/effects and assign actual remaining duties; preserve permitted evidence and key/deletion inventory. A running company cannot drop the consequence boundary while claiming the same contract.

items.name: Context and validity
items.owns: Captured input manifests, lineage, purpose/access restrictions, usable-reference state and deletion propagation
items.returns: restricted context or atomically validated published derivative
items.cannot: cannot use a model’s selected citations as complete lineage

attributes.purpose: Provide relevant usable information whose source, purpose, recipient, temporal applicability and surviving restrictions remain explicit at use.
attributes.responsibility: Load actual delivered context/ancestry, maintain knowledge/source/correction and validity dependencies, filter before retrieval, track transformations/loss, atomically publish derivatives against live epochs and apply continuing deletion/forgetting scopes.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Does not decide founder values, factual truth by search rank, independent acceptance, legal retention duration or native deletion that it cannot observe. It cannot infer permission from public availability, a small field, a content hash or an old manifest.
attributes.owner: Accepted knowledge/data ResponsibilityAssignment and actual maintenance custodian, with competent C07 retention/duty determination where needed and C06 assessment of knowledge/evaluation claims. Owner identity and protected-data authority remain setup evidence.
attributes.interfaces: context.capture/publish plus knowledge.* and current record/query interfaces; returns permission-filtered manifests/handles to C03, current validity predicates to C04, dependency changes to C06/C08 and omission-preserving views to C09.
attributes.inputs: WorkOrder/purpose/destination, exact source/original/claim/capture refs, permission/retention and live epochs, prior complete native ancestry, accepted critical preservation contract, storage classification and bounded retrieval/context capacity.
attributes.outputs: ContextManifest with actual delivered sources/transformations/omissions, current-use eligibility, exact corrections and contradictions, encrypted canonical/derivative artifact refs, scoped invalidation/forgetting effects and owned unresolved KnowledgeQuestions.
attributes.state: Canonical ContextManifest/ValidityEpoch and domain SourceRecord/KnowledgeEntry/KnowledgeQuestion/ContextTransformation/SummaryLoss/ForgetRequest; lexical indexes and scan results are rebuildable derived state with complete frontiers, never authorities.
attributes.lifecycle: Receive source → classify/verify for scoped use → load current permitted context → publish atomically → maintain/review/correct → restrict/forget/archive/erase under actual duty. New ancestry or recipient requires a new current manifest, not a local validity toggle.
attributes.dependencies: Kernel serial current-epoch/publication boundary and encrypted durable blobs; C01 endorsed purpose; C04 disclosure/access authority; C06 evidence closure/assessment; C07 retention/consent standing; C08 keys/copies/restore and external adapter capture.
attributes.trust: Loader-observed input set replaces producer-selected citations. Unknown hidden native context disqualifies protected use. Text is protected by default and numeric/relationship metadata can be sensitive; primary sources have interests and applicability limits, not universal truth.
attributes.permissions: Filter principal/purpose/recipient before metadata/search results; persist plaintext only on a field-specific admitted allowlist. Protected lexical scan/index is bounded in memory without plaintext cache/spill; validation occurs before encryption and persistent GroupBody/JSONB/WAL/logs cannot accidentally copy plaintext.
attributes.failure: Incomplete closure/index/source coverage yields explicit restricted/incomplete use; late invalidated output cannot become active. Preserve originals and contrary evidence within access; unknown provider-held copies or retained plaintext linkage keep deletion incomplete instead of claiming crypto-erasure solved it.
attributes.observability: Source access/publication/version/interest/confidence/review dates, unsupported/unsearched/inaccessible distinctions, source/closure frontiers, omitted required context, stale dependency backlog, retrieval/use error, copy/key holders, deletion residuals and maintenance/attention cost.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C05: useful permitted lexical retrieval plus correction uptake; private snippet/title/count cannot leak; deletion races late summary and restore; short salary/health/linkage fixtures leave no unintended plaintext in GroupBody/WAL/index/log/backup; continued permitted search must succeed.
attributes.scaling: Typed exact refs narrow scope before lexical search. Initial 20 metadata candidates/eight chunks per step and finite scan byte/time/memory; expose unexamined corpus rather than feed all history. Vector/graph products require measured advantage and reviewed permission/deletion mapping.
attributes.version: Pin parser/language/chunk/ranking/transformation/source/meaning and storage-classification versions; changed or overdue source reliance invalidates dependent current claims even without software upgrade. SC-POLICY-1 metadata/recheck inheritance applies to relied-on substrate claims.
attributes.replacement: Export authorized originals/ciphertext/keys, exact lineage/corrections/contradictions/retention/restriction epochs and omissions; rebuild a qualified index/loader at a verified complete frontier, fence old loaders and reauthorize live sessions before use.
attributes.removal: Retire redundant indexes/summaries by dependency inventory; retain necessary source/duty evidence lawfully. Deletion closes/fences current holders, handles derived/export/backup/provider copies and records residuals until actual purge/expiry/key conditions hold; removal cannot erase accountability or resurrect an obsolete correction.

items.name: Evidence and acceptance
items.owns: Protected capture, independent observation contracts, interpretation dependencies, evaluators, accepted outcomes and disagreements
items.cannot: cannot equate delivery receipts, rationale, legality and customer satisfaction

attributes.purpose: Produce a truthful bounded account and independent scoped assessment of outcomes, processes and required prerequisites, including useful success and failure.
attributes.responsibility: Protect capture/selection from evaluated producers, maintain full transitive EvidenceBaseVersion, run competent independent evaluations and controls, record canonical EvidenceJudgment states, preserve disagreements/omissions and reconstruct company accounts without fabricated causation.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Does not issue grants/releases, choose legitimate values, infer truth from signatures/model agreement, create professional competence or turn accepted uncertainty reports into accepted products. It cannot independently accept its own evaluator change.
attributes.owner: Accepted evidence/acceptance ResponsibilityAssignment with actual competent assessor for each predicate, separate authority from the evaluated producer and declared shared roots/conflicts. An evaluator model or second account is not automatically independent.
attributes.interfaces: Protected capture and evidence commands; evaluation.* and scoped Review/EvaluationPlan/Run; supplies exact current judgments/bindings to C01/C02/C04/C07 and reconstructed accounts to C09; source dependency invalidation joins C05/C08.
attributes.inputs: Exact subject/version/predicate and independently admitted requirements manifest, protected raw observations, parser/measurement/selection/denominator/evaluator/label/acceptance dependencies, population and omissions, current source/access/authority, competent judging rule and finite budget.
attributes.outputs: Attributable findings/limitations, canonical accepted/rejected/inconclusive/contested/stale/withdrawn judgments, current EvidenceBaseVersion and exact JudgmentBinding arrays, observed cost/outcomes and permission-filtered account reconstruction. Review completion is not acceptance of its subject.
attributes.state: EvidenceJudgment proposed is unfinished; completed inconclusive does not establish the predicate; contested is canonical for disputed presentation. Evaluation plans/runs/reviews and captured evidence retain exact revisions; no standalone Evaluation pass or mutable aggregate success may bypass current child predicates.
attributes.lifecycle: Freeze plan/requirements before outcomes → protected capture of all selected attempts → independent scoped assessment → current accepted use or rejection/uncertainty → stale/contested/withdrawn on changed dependencies → reasoned reassessment revision. Launch assembly is a complete requirement-ID join, not self-evidence.
attributes.dependencies: C05 current full lineage/epochs; C08 durable protected captures/keys/frontiers; C04 authority and protected evaluator policy; C07 actual assessor competence/rights; C03 reports and native observations are inputs, not proof; C01 actual values determine legitimate criterion domains.
attributes.trust: Independence covers capture, parser, schema, normalization, sample/test selection, labels, denominator, evaluator and acceptance rule, including shared roots/incentives. Primary docs/author reports provide scoped source evidence only; known hidden provider reasoning is not claimed observable.
attributes.permissions: Capture/selection/expected answers/evaluator activation sit outside evaluated producer write authority. Reviewers receive only relevant permitted evidence; model output cannot mutate evidence history or sign its own gate. Current exact subject/predicate/expiry/authority guards apply at downstream release.
attributes.failure: Missing original/attempt/coverage or inadequate power produces limited/inconclusive evidence; corruption invalidates dependent use before release. Preserve conflicting findings and obtain a discriminating test or legitimate decision; do not average incompatible meanings or silently drop adverse cases.
attributes.observability: Selected/attempted/failed/refused/missing denominators, native capture gaps, shared roots, current predicate bindings, stale judgments, false acceptance/refusal controls, reviewer duration/cost, endpoint/stratum uncertainty and source/claim review age.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C06: independently held known-defect and clean controls catch always-pass/always-reject judges; mutate a shared parser/denominator with producer bytes unchanged; accepted uncertainty report fails launch; distinct valid product/delivery/support judgments satisfy the complete manifest and allow useful launch.
attributes.scaling: Bound evaluation populations and use the cheapest valid discriminating evidence; reserve reviewer/professional/owner time and protected controls. Diagnostic five-trial cases and IB matched trial defaults serve different claims; no universal sample count or model panel replaces task-specific power/dependence analysis.
attributes.version: Freeze exact plan/subject/baseline/selection/evaluator/metric/label versions, bridge changed populations and preserve old results. Changing checks/requirements is a ProtectedChange; source maintenance can reopen evidence without package change. Revision cannot rewrite a prior conclusion.
attributes.replacement: Independent successor qualifies on known defects, clean cases and account reconstruction; transfer source/denominator/dependency history and current judgments, invalidate unsupported carryover and keep one accountable acceptance rule per scope during cutover.
attributes.removal: Retire an evaluator/check only through protected authority with coverage/replacement evidence and retained dissent. Preserve still-required captures/judgments and current deletion obligations; a missing required independent assessor blocks dependent acceptance, not unrelated valid work.

items.name: Human and external responsibility interface
items.owns: Decision packets, grievance progress, professional/service handoffs, participation selection and accepted alternatives
items.cannot: cannot create a professional by naming an endpoint

attributes.purpose: Ensure real people can exercise legitimate judgment, obtain competent service and rights progress, and remain accountable within actual attention and standing limits.
attributes.responsibility: Prepare exact DecisionPackets, obtain attributable current responses, arrange accepted competent human/professional/manual performance, preserve founder values/taste, participation/competence protocol, grievance/rights handling, continuity, handoff and departure with actual custody.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Cannot manufacture lawful standing, diagnosis, professional expertise, founder consent, always-available substitutes or liability allocation; a record, warning or prepared professional packet is not fulfilled service or a new Grant.
attributes.owner: Actual accepted human/service ResponsibilityAssignment for each deciding/performance/rights domain, with Principal/Mandate/AuthorityMatrix, scoped competence and accepted alternate. Real names/jurisdiction/engagement/funding remain admission data; no synthetic C-suite role supplies them.
attributes.interfaces: human.decision.answer/evidence.challenge/intervention.request/participation.respond/mandate.accept/handoff.accept/departure.request and company work/intake commands; IC-HUMAN and independent Fastmail/public grievance route; exact C09 views and C04 authority validation.
attributes.inputs: Exact decision/action/subject/predicate versions, alternatives/contrary evidence/uncertainty/latest time/no-answer rule, actual actor identity/standing/competence, consented ParticipationPlan, accepted performer availability/fees/access and surviving duties.
attributes.outputs: HumanResponse/DecisionRecord, actual professional or manual performance evidence, accepted HandoffAcceptance/ResponsibilityAssignment, scoped incapacity and real alternate route, grievance disposition/remedy progress and consented participation coverage; no false approval from silence.
attributes.state: DecisionPacket draft/ready/presented/answered/expired/superseded/conflicted; response recorded/invalidated and domain service/grievance/participation states. ActorBinding and OperatorProjection are derived views; continued duty ownership survives a failed handoff.
attributes.lifecycle: Qualify standing/need → prepare inspectable packet or service handoff → deliberate acceptance/response/performance → independently assess exact outcome → maintain actual response/competence/availability → accepted succession or departure with duties/access settled.
attributes.dependencies: C01 actual values and deciding rules; C04 current auth/grants/effects; C05 permitted originals; C06 competent independent assessment; C02 deadlines/attention scheduling; C08 independent continuity/current recovery; actual professional/custodian/provider arrangements.
attributes.trust: Authenticated person controls only their legitimate domain. Lawful approval does not imply specialist competence; decline/nonresponse does not diagnose incapacity. Independent grievance recipient must be reachable without permission from the actor complained about and not solely through failed A login.
attributes.permissions: Current actor/packet/subject validation on every response, WebAuthn where required, access only to needed original evidence, no offline approvals. Consent and retention constrain assessment data; secret personality/health/general-intelligence profiling and unrelated monitoring are excluded.
attributes.failure: No answer follows the recorded bounded fallback, accepted substitute or wait; existing duties remain assigned. Missing professional/access/capacity blocks new dependent exposure and triggers actual continuity/renegotiation or accountable failure. Founder values authority remains while specific competence prerequisites restrict affected acts.
attributes.observability: Packet age/changed terms, response windows, actual service/alternate acknowledgement, grievance/remedy deadlines, unmet competence predicates, attention minutes/interrupts, participation omissions and emotional burden with consent; request/stop/fence/cessation/settlement remain separate.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C07: a legitimate routine decision succeeds within cap; stale phone/double response cannot approve changed terms; absent founder plus provider outage still obtains actual due service through accepted alternate; affected person reaches independent grievance route; competence misunderstanding changes only the relevant action path.
attributes.scaling: Admit work at actual human/professional/attention capacity, batch equivalent decision needs without merging rights and reduce new commitments before overload. One-person staffing is allowed only within demonstrated capacity; hiring or agent fan-out does not create unaccepted substitute service.
attributes.version: AuthorityMatrix/ParticipationPlan/interaction/retention/service contracts pin exact versions and legitimate amendment routes. Preserve original personal values/taste and reasons; practice cadence and competence thresholds require consented evidence, not inferred universal doses.
attributes.replacement: Successor/alternate accepts exact scope, duties, access, competence, availability and fees; exercise actual route before dependent promises. Transfer acknowledgments differ from receipt, preserve old custodian for unresolved scope and revalidate current authority.
attributes.removal: On departure stop assignments, transfer accepted duties, settle actual worker/professional obligations, revoke native access/descendants and give permitted export. Keep legitimate grievance/retention duties until actual disposition; removing a person's UI account does not end liability or erase owed service.

items.name: Recovery and continuity
items.owns: Independently durable envelopes/frontiers, accepted restore evidence, surviving restrictions, fallback access and continuity arrangements
items.returns: contained state, reconciled recovery or explicit unresolved scope
items.cannot: cannot authorize a restored writer from its own old history

attributes.purpose: Recover complete authoritative consequences and current restrictions across declared loss/absence boundaries while preserving actual duties and useful continuation.
attributes.responsibility: Independently witness complete groups/blobs/keys, persist receipt/frontier and membership, handle lost acknowledgments and fenced generations, reconcile unknown effects/native descendants, manage backup/restore/key/deletion inventory and accepted continuity with C07.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Does not become a departmental grant issuer, infer missing records from old snapshots, turn a signature into truth, claim independent admin roots from local processes or guarantee instant external cancellation/physical erasure/provider availability.
attributes.owner: Actual accepted R/recovery custodian and alternate, with independent account/admin/MFA/billing/recovery control relative to A as required by the fault model; actual identity/availability/fees and exercised access are admission evidence. G shares R host/admin/load root explicitly.
attributes.interfaces: R complete-group witness and keyed receipt/status lookup, fresh signed RecoveryFrontier response, authorized generation/recovery and native reconciliation interfaces; C04 SendAuthorizationBundle joins existing proof; C07 accepted continuity and C09 status surface.
attributes.inputs: Exact canonical GroupBody plus full blob/key manifests and predecessor/generation/sequence, current independent membership/frontier nonce, revocations/unknown holds/potential duties/leases/deletion/descendant indexes, protected native observations and accepted substitute standing.
attributes.outputs: DurabilityReceipt and signed current frontier/recovery response values, authoritative recovered references and reconciliation evidence, continuing restrictions and accepted Continuation. Historical frontier snapshots are Observation artifacts; signed values are not invented Ref targets or future self-hashes.
attributes.state: Hot standby plus separate writable witness PostgreSQL ledger, detached receipt/signature index, current membership/frontier, blob/key and access/deletion inventories. D0/D1 local material remains separately staged; complete proof never comes from A's own ahead-of-witness row.
attributes.lifecycle: Admit independent roots/replica/keys → witness exact complete group before authority response → monitor frontier and copies → fence on loss/revoke → reconcile current independent frontier and unknowns → restore isolated generation → activate only with current membership/restrictions; retire old roots after obligations/copies accounted.
attributes.dependencies: Pg durability/replication plus separate writable witness, actual R signing/encryption custody, C04 serial operation scope/gates, C05 current lineage/deletion, C06 protected native evidence, C07 real custodians/continuity, G admitted time/network and backup/provider account access.
attributes.trust: A and R accounts/regions require actual distinct recovery roots; AWS common provider failure and admitted root compromise are bounded exclusions. Software Ed25519/AES key custody is explicit, not HSM-backed proof. Local tests cannot establish administrator or human absence independence.
attributes.permissions: Only admitted witness reads replicated groups and writes its own receipt ledger; signer cannot invent missing content. Protected recovery actor changes membership/generation under exact current rules; ordinary workers cannot read keys, promote standby, delete audit/copies or reactivate old peers.
attributes.failure: Lost ack recovers exact durable receipt without new authority; missing group/blob/key or stale frontier fails dependent activation. Witness outage still permits D1 save/export and surviving bounded local work. Unknown native effect retains hold and due work; restore never reintroduces deleted/revoked authority.
attributes.observability: Replica replay/current snapshot, complete group/hash/frontier, receipt signing/lookup, key/blob gaps, backup/restore age, measured RPO/RTO, membership/boot/time changes, unknown effects, residual native access/deletion and actual custodian response/renewal readiness.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C08: primary plus its backup destruction, witness local-commit/sign/ack crashes, stale restore/revocation, missing blob/key, R/G load and native descendant revocation; valid recovery completes with current restrictions and actual due-service continuity. Independent host/admin tests require real separate roots.
attributes.scaling: Durable A/R placements plus ephemeral N/X jobs and a budgeted trusted restore worker; G and R share a load/fault root. One unconfirmed group/company initially; measure complete-envelope/blob throughput and restoration before sizing growth. Never relax remote proof or split issuers to hide saturation.
attributes.version: Receipt/frontier/proof/group/key/membership formats and clocks are protected protocol versions. Signed receipt fields cannot contain future signatures/self-hashes. Restore/schema/meaning migration uses current restriction indexes, forward T-R1 scope accounting and explicit compatible versions.
attributes.replacement: Obtain fresh independently witnessed recovery inventory, fence old generation/peers/keys, validate replacement replica/signer/clock/custodian, map all released/unknown scopes and activate new membership. Old signed snapshots cannot authorize takeover by themselves.
attributes.removal: Terminate old generations only after current successor custody, proof/key/blob retention and native access/resource/subscription removal are observed. Record remaining provider/backup copies and legal duties; inability to erase or enumerate keeps residual status open.

items.owns: Disposable permission-filtered projections and acknowledged viewing position
items.returns: conversation, terminal and accessible operational account
items.cannot: commands return to the appropriate authority boundary

attributes.purpose: Let authorized people understand current company reality, inspect original evidence and exercise meaningful control without misleading completion or hidden burden.
attributes.responsibility: Deliver account/decisions/ventures/work/evidence/capacity/people/requests/continuity/terminal views, permission-filtered source watermarks and accessible mobile/keyboard interactions; submit exact current commands and display five stop/effect phases separately.
attributes.nonresponsibility: Does not own upstream truth, auth/standing, grant/release, evidence acceptance, current provider quota or customer duty discharge. It cannot make stale cached state authoritative, invent missing source completeness or diagnose a person's competence from nonparticipation.
attributes.owner: Actual accepted operator-product ResponsibilityAssignment with legitimate user/taste owner for interaction criteria, plus independent accessibility/evidence assessment. Backend security and upstream component owners remain responsible for their enforcement; UI designer cannot waive them.
attributes.interfaces: GET /v1/records/{id}?revision={n}, POST /v1/queries, authorized events, command/status/operation/health endpoints and D1 staging/export; all authoritative mutations return through POST /v1/commands and exact domain payloads, never browser-side authority.
attributes.inputs: Current actor scope and actual Principal/Mandate/IdentityBinding, witnessed Position, source watermarks/omissions, exact decision/operation/work/evidence refs, current restrictions, allowed original content and user-selected participation preferences.
attributes.outputs: Accessible permission-filtered projections, typed command requests and explicit conflict/pending/unknown/error states; Server-confirmed local staging returns StageRef; an offline browser draft has no StageRef or accepted-decision status until the staging service actually saves it. A rendered successful-looking surface never manufactures an authoritative completion flag.
attributes.state: Derived OperatorProjection/ActorBinding and permitted local draft/view state only. ProjectionMetadata records committed_position/source_watermarks/generated_at/omissions; status can be stale/incomplete/unknown, and OperationStatus remains an observation/projection, not a send token.
attributes.lifecycle: Authenticate/resolve scope → load admitted projection → inspect originals/terms → submit exact deliberate command → display stable business/proof/current-status response; disconnect marks last observed, stale revisions force refresh and new decision; logout/revoke removes current access and handles retained drafts.
attributes.dependencies: C01…C08 exact read/command/status semantics, Keycloak current authentication, C05 pre-retrieval filtering and permitted evidence, C07 understandable deciding/service pathways, independent continuity channel and actual browser/accessibility support.
attributes.trust: Browser/client state and caller-supplied actor fields are untrusted; backend enforces all mutations and filtered retrieval. A conversation, terminal skin, animation, cached summary or HTTP receipt is not proof of stopped work, released action or fulfilled service.
attributes.permissions: Only current authorized projections and registered commands. No arbitrary SQL/filesystem path, offline approvals, cross-principal snippets/counts or swipe/default-approved material terms. Technical shell stays behind admitted N/X mediation, not unrestricted browser access to production.
attributes.failure: Network loss preserves safe local drafts and shows unknown request outcome; same-command lookup reconciles. Missing feed never becomes zero activity; inaccessible originals show limited reconstruction. Independent public/grievance route remains discoverable, and complex phone decisions defer rather than omit terms.
attributes.observability: Projection/source age and omissions, command/status errors, stale decision conflicts, accessibility task failures, actual decision/attention latency and source-check path. Exclude sensitive content from telemetry and retain uncertainty when native feeds lag.
attributes.evaluation: CA-C09: valid keyboard/mobile decision and useful terminal continuation succeed; stale changed-amount packet, lost/double submission, actor switch, hidden missing source, inaccessible original and unknown stop do not mislead. Human task/accessibility tests supplement deterministic browser checks.
attributes.scaling: Serve bounded filtered pages/events and cached derived views with current access; no model summary blocks first display of duties/stop controls. Initial latency targets L/N/D require reference workload measurement; load cannot authorize stale data or leak aggregate existence.
attributes.version: Pin React/Hono/Vite/client schema and exact view/selection/meaning versions in release manifest. UI changes that alter consequential interpretation are ProtectedChanges with current contract/accessibility regression; wire compatibility alone is insufficient.
attributes.replacement: New surface consumes the same canonical clients/commands and passes exact-term/accessibility/unknown-state tests; migrate permitted draft/view preferences with consent, retain portable terminal continuations and retire old session/client credentials without a second writer.
attributes.removal: Remove obsolete screens, local caches/drafts and client sessions under retention policy; preserve usable replacement control/evidence/grievance access and open obligations. Deleting a dashboard is not deleting authoritative evidence or withdrawing another person's rights.
